claim: § Torus Knots on T² + Open Questions: a rational ratio of phase and frame rates closes the path into a (p,q) torus knot, an irrational one fills the torus; and the Berry-phase claim that two paths with the same winding at different speeds accumulate the same spectral change.

pieces.what: A torus with a ratio control: the scan path closes into a trefoil at 2:3, fills the surface at an irrational ratio, and you hear the knot repeat or the drift shimmer.
pieces.walks_up_from: one circle, phase read at fixed frame

pieces.what: The listening experiment the page proposes: the same (2,3,1) winding at three overall rates, to hear whether timbre per cycle is speed-independent.
Turn B and watch the fibre twist once around the base circle; orbits close at rational monodromy, fill at irrational.
The existing Hopf control surface and its tours laid beside the section.
